seoTitle: One Piece Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the One Piece test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Luffy, Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, Chopper, Robin or Franky. Get your full Straw Hat breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who charges in without a plan, the one counting every coin, or the one who's always cooking for the crew? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, dreams and adventure, and find out which Straw Hat you are.

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.title: The Unstoppable Captain
characters.summary: Carefree, fearless and loyal to the bone. You follow your gut, you never give up, and you'd do anything for your friends.
description: Like Luffy, you have one huge dream and nothing will stop you. He's set out to become King of the Pirates, wearing the straw hat he was given as a boy by the pirate Shanks.
You're simple in the best way. Luffy loves adventure, freedom and meat, in roughly that order, and he doesn't overthink anything.
But you're the one people follow. Luffy will take on anyone, even whole governments, if they hurt his friends, and that's why his crew would follow him anywhere.
characters.flaw: You act first and think... well, you mostly just act.
characters.signature: A straw hat, a huge grin and a plate piled with meat.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into trouble without a second thought

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.title: The Unbreakable Swordsman
characters.summary: Tough, disciplined and fiercely loyal. You say little, train hard and keep your promises.
description: Like Zoro, you have a promise you won't break. He's sworn to become the world's greatest swordsman, a dream he shared with his childhood friend Kuina.
You're all about discipline. Zoro fights with three swords, trains constantly and pushes through pain other people couldn't imagine.
Off duty, you're very relaxed. Zoro is famous for napping anywhere, drinking anything and getting lost in a straight corridor.
characters.flaw: You'd rather die than ask for directions.
characters.signature: Three swords, a nap in the sun and absolutely no sense of direction.
characters.clashReason: they'd grunt at you, then fall asleep mid-conversation

characters.name: Nami
characters.title: The Smart Navigator
characters.summary: Sharp, practical and very good with money. You're the brains of the group, and you've fought hard for everything you have.
description: Like Nami, you're the smart one. She's the crew's navigator, able to read the weather and the sea better than anyone, and she dreams of drawing a map of the whole world.
You love money, and you're not ashamed of it. Nami counts every Berry, and she'll happily charge interest on a loan to her own captain.
You're tougher than you look. As a girl, Nami worked for years for the pirates who ruled her village, secretly saving to buy it back.
characters.flaw: You're a bit too fond of money, and a bit too quick with your fists.
characters.signature: A map, a tangerine and a bill for everything you borrowed.
characters.clashReason: they'd charge you interest on everything you owe

characters.name: Usopp
characters.title: The Storyteller
characters.summary: Creative, funny and scared of almost everything, but when it counts, you're far braver than you think.
description: Like Usopp, you're a great storyteller, and not every story is strictly true. He's the crew's sniper, an inventor and a world-class exaggerator.
You're scared, and you say so. Usopp is famous for sudden "illnesses" that stop him going anywhere dangerous.
But you keep showing up. Usopp dreams of becoming a brave warrior of the sea like his father, Yasopp, and when his friends need him, he faces his fears.
characters.flaw: You talk yourself up, then panic when people believe you.
characters.signature: A slingshot, a wild story and a very convenient illness.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you a story that was mostly made up

characters.name: Sanji
characters.title: The Chef With a Big Heart
characters.summary: Stylish, generous and hopelessly romantic. You'd never let anyone go hungry, and you fall in love every five minutes.
description: Like Sanji, you show love with food. He's the crew's chef, and he'll feed anyone who's hungry, even an enemy.
That comes from something real. As a boy, Sanji nearly starved while stranded on a rock with the chef Zeff, and he's never forgotten it.
You're a big romantic. Sanji swoons over every beautiful woman he meets, and he dreams of finding the All Blue, a sea where fish from every ocean meet.
characters.flaw: Someone pretty smiles at you and your brain switches off.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a cigarette and a perfect plate of food for whoever needs it.
characters.clashReason: they'd flirt with everyone at the table, including your date

characters.name: Tony Tony Chopper
characters.title: The Sweet Little Doctor
characters.summary: Kind, shy and adorable. You want to help everyone, even if you're too embarrassed to accept a compliment.
description: Like Chopper, you're a caregiver at heart. He's the crew's doctor, and he dreams of becoming a cure for any illness.
You've felt like an outsider. Chopper is a reindeer who ate a Devil Fruit that made him part human, and he was rejected by other reindeer and humans alike.
You're terrible at hiding your feelings. Tell Chopper he's amazing and he'll insist it doesn't make him happy at all, while doing a delighted little dance.
characters.flaw: You're so shy that you hide from people, badly.
characters.signature: A big pink hat, a medical bag and a very obvious hiding place.
characters.clashReason: they'd pretend not to be pleased when they obviously are

characters.name: Nico Robin
characters.title: The Calm Scholar
characters.summary: Calm, clever and mysterious. You've been through a lot, and you've come out wise, kind and quietly funny.
description: Like Robin, you're a thinker. She's an archaeologist who can read the ancient Poneglyphs, and she wants to uncover the lost history the World Government tried to erase.
You've survived things most people couldn't. Robin lost her home island, Ohara, as a child and spent years on the run with nobody to trust.
Now you've found your people. Robin is calm, kind and has a very dark sense of humour, and with the Straw Hats she finally learned she wants to live.
characters.flaw: You're so used to being alone that you forget people want to help.
characters.signature: A book, a coffee and a slightly worrying joke delivered with a smile.
characters.clashReason: they'd say something alarming, calmly, and go back to their book

characters.name: Franky
characters.title: The Super Builder
characters.summary: Loud, emotional and full of energy. You can build anything, and you're not afraid to cry at a sad story.
description: Like Franky, you love making things. He's the crew's shipwright, a cyborg who built them their ship, the Thousand Sunny, and dreams of building a ship that can sail to the end of the world.
You're loud and proud. Franky strikes poses, shouts that everything is "SUPER" and runs on cola.
You're a softie underneath. Franky cries at sad stories, and, although he'll deny it, he's usually the first one in tears.
characters.flaw: You're dramatic about everything, including your own crying.
characters.signature: A pose, a bottle of cola and something he built this morning.
characters.clashReason: they'd be much, much too loud

questions.text: You've planned a date with someone you really like. On the night you...

options.text: Cook them a three-course meal and compliment them all night
Turn up late. You got lost on the way
Ask thoughtful questions and really listen to the answers
Tell them the story of the time you fought off a giant sea monster. Allegedly

questions.text: A friend is in trouble a long way away. You...

options.text: Go, right now. No plan needed
Set off immediately, and probably get lost on the way
Work out the fastest route first, then go
Grab a first-aid kit and run

questions.text: Someone laughs at your dream to your face. You...

options.text: Say nothing. You'll prove them wrong
Laugh along. You're going to do it anyway
Tell them a slightly exaggerated story about how great you'll be
Get so fired up about it you nearly cry

questions.text: The day is yours to waste however you like. You...

options.text: Nap somewhere sunny, and wake up for dinner
Try a new recipe and feed everyone who walks past
Read quietly with a coffee
Build something in the garage

questions.text: Someone at the table is clearly still hungry. You...

options.text: Cook for them immediately. Nobody goes hungry on your watch
Offer them some of yours, after you've eaten most of it
Offer them seconds, for a small fee
Ask if they've been eating properly lately. You're worried

questions.text: You're facing the thing you're most afraid of. You...

options.text: Admit it loudly, then do it anyway, legs shaking
Hide. Badly
Stay calm. You've survived far worse
Grin. Scary things are the most fun

questions.text: Someone gives you a big compliment. You...

options.text: Insist it doesn't make you happy, while smiling from ear to ear
Melt completely, especially if they're gorgeous
Strike a pose. You know you look good
Grunt. Moving on

questions.text: You join a weekend class to learn something hands-on. You choose...

options.text: Sculpting or painting. You're great with your hands
Learning to predict the weather
Welding. Anything with sparks
An ancient language nobody speaks any more

questions.text: Your group is splitting a big bill. You...

options.text: Work out every cent, and remind people what they still owe you
Realise you forgot your wallet. Again
Insist on treating everyone
Pay your share, then tell a story about the time you paid for everyone

questions.text: A friend admits they have a painful past they've never told anyone about. You...

options.text: Tell them you don't need to know. They're your friend, that's it
Understand completely. Some things you only share when you're ready
Nod. You've got their back either way
Tell them it doesn't change anything, and hug them

questions.text: You're a pirate. Your captain wants to storm a heavily guarded fortress to save one friend, against terrible odds. You...

options.text: Draw your weapon. Captain's orders
Complain loudly, then plan the escape route
Suddenly come down with an illness that stops you going near fortresses. Then go anyway
Build something that'll get everyone through the walls

questions.text: You're sailing the world on a ship with your crew. A rich stranger offers you a fortune for the ship. You...

options.text: Never. You built it with your own hands
Think about it, seriously. It's a fortune
No way. The ship is part of the crew
Ask what they really want it for
